name: Vowel Snake
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Sing the snake around the board. Five sung vowels steer it — I = up, A = down, E = left, U = right — and O is the extra action: hold it for a burst of boost that drains a meter and recharges when you rest. Vowels are detected live from your mic by the same formant analysis (weighted LPC + root finding) the Formant Tracker uses, so clean, sustained vowel targets win — a real articulation workout disguised as a game. Pure DSP, no model.
